contract: Road user x departs to the left of a travel carrier's designated direction at the observation: it moves forward along the carrier while its velocity points to the left of the carrier's direction by more than a tolerance. It holds where x is moving (drv.motion.moving with speed_floor), the component of its velocity (kin.velocity, m/s, world frame) along the carrier's designated direction (st.lane_direction, read normalised) is positive, and the cross product of that direction with the velocity, left positive, exceeds sine_tolerance times x's speed (kin.speed): the sine of the angle from the designated direction to the velocity is above sine_tolerance. Unknown where the carrier carries no designated direction. Not denoted: x's heading (a body may point across a carrier while moving along it), motion against the carrier's direction, x being on the carrier (the caller states occupancy), a signal, or how far x has moved sideways.

params.name: speed_floor
params.meaning: the source's speed resolution, below which a reading counts as no motion

params.name: sine_tolerance
params.meaning: the sine of the angle between the velocity and the designated direction above which the motion counts as departing to one side rather than tracking the carrier

elements.justification: drv.motion.moving: "A road user is in motion at the observation: its speed exceeds speed_floor".
kin.velocity: "velocity vector", m/s, world frame; the direction of motion, not the heading.

elements.span: the carrier's designated direction (st.lane_direction, read normalised)
elements.justification: st.lane_direction: "direction of travel designated for a structure a vehicle travels in", read normalised; unknown where the carrier carries none.
kin.speed: "magnitude of velocity"; the cross product is compared with the tolerance times the speed, so no division by a measurement.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: x moves along lane c with its velocity turned to the left of c's designated direction by more than the angle whose sine is sine_tolerance, as at the start of a lane change to the left.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: x moves along lane c with its velocity parallel to c's designated direction.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: x moves to the left across lane c, but c's designated direction is not observed.
